## Specialisms

Frontend: React, Next.js (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
Backend: Laravel, PHP, Node.js, Express
Data: MongoDB, MySQL, PostgreSQL, Redis, Prisma, Mongoose
Commerce: Shopify, Liquid, Hydrogen, headless storefronts
Platform: Docker, REST and GraphQL API design, technical SEO, web performance

## Services

- [Enterprise backends with Laravel](https://wpseemol.site/services#laravel-backend): Secure, scalable APIs with authentication, payment integrations, admin dashboards and queue-driven background work.
- [High-performance frontends with Next.js](https://wpseemol.site/services#nextjs-frontend): Fast, SEO-ready, accessible interfaces using SSG, SSR and ISR, with Core Web Vitals treated as acceptance criteria.
- [Custom full-stack MERN applications](https://wpseemol.site/services#mern-fullstack): End-to-end products with MongoDB, Express, React and Node, including real-time features over WebSockets.
- [Shopify themes and custom apps](https://wpseemol.site/services#shopify-development): Conversion-focused storefronts, custom Online Store 2.0 themes, and embedded apps on the Shopify Admin API.

## Projects

- **Laravel E-Commerce API** (PHP, 2025) — REST API covering the full commerce lifecycle. Stock decrements inside database transactions to prevent overselling under concurrency; payment webhooks are idempotent. https://github.com/wpseemol/laravel-ecommerce-api
- **Next.js Dashboard Starter** (TypeScript, 2025) — App Router admin starter with auth, protected routes, server-side pagination on large tables, role-gated navigation and a no-flash theme system. https://github.com/wpseemol/nextjs-dashboard
- **MERN Task Manager** (JavaScript, 2024) — Kanban workspace where board changes broadcast over WebSockets so concurrent edits stay in sync. Optimistic UI with the server as source of truth. https://github.com/wpseemol/mern-task-manager
